name: Frog
description: The Tamiya Frog (1983) is one of Tamiya's earliest competitive off-road racing buggies. Its distinctive bug-eye body and mid-motor 2WD layout were designed for 1/10 scale racing. Notably, the Frog ships with multiple interchangeable pinion and spur gears, allowing gear ratio tuning, and includes TRF-style friction dampers for its era.

hopUps.name: 3x10mm Titanium Round Head Screw (10 pcs.)
hopUps.description: Titanium alloy upgrade for the stock 3x10mm steel screws. Significantly lighter and corrosion-resistant while matching the strength of steel screws.

hopUps.name: 3x20mm Titanium Round Head Screw (10 pcs.)
hopUps.description: Titanium alloy upgrade for the stock 3x20mm steel screws. Lighter and rust-proof.

hopUps.name: 3x12mm Titanium Tapping Screw (10 pcs.)
hopUps.description: Titanium tapping screw upgrade replacing the stock 3x12mm steel tapping screws used in plastic parts.

hopUps.name: 3x15mm Titanium Tapping Screw (10 pcs.)
hopUps.description: Titanium tapping screw upgrade replacing the stock 3x15mm steel tapping screws.

hopUps.name: 3mm Aluminum Lock Nut (10 pcs.)
hopUps.description: Lightweight aluminium lock nuts replacing the stock steel lock nuts. Reduces unsprung weight on suspension components.

hopUps.name: 1150 Sealed Ball Bearing Set (2 pcs.)
hopUps.description: Sealed 1150 ball bearings for replacing plastic bearings (MD1) in the drivetrain. Sold in sets of 2 to allow gradual upgrading.
hopUps.notes: Stock kit includes 4 sealed bearings (53008) and 10 plastic bearings (MD1). This set lets you replace the remaining plastic bearings incrementally.

hopUps.name: Silicone Damper Oil Soft Set (#200, #300, #400)
hopUps.description: Three bottles of soft-weight silicone damper oil for tuning the Frog's friction dampers. Lower viscosity oils give a softer, more compliant suspension feel.
hopUps.notes: Use with the stock TRF-style dampers or the optional TRF damper piston (53572). Start with #300 on most tracks.

hopUps.name: Silicone Damper Oil Medium Set (#500, #600, #700)
hopUps.description: Three bottles of medium-weight silicone damper oil. A balanced choice for general track conditions and mixed surfaces.

hopUps.name: Silicone Damper Oil Hard Set (#800, #900, #1000)
hopUps.description: Three bottles of high-viscosity silicone damper oil. Stiffer damping suits smooth, hard-packed tracks where minimal body roll is needed.

hopUps.name: TRF Damper Piston (2-Hole, 4 pcs.)
hopUps.description: Two-hole damper pistons to replace the stock three-hole pistons (53573). Fewer holes increase damping resistance for a firmer suspension response.
hopUps.notes: The stock kit includes 3-hole pistons (53573). Switching to 2-hole increases damping force without changing oil weight.

hopUps.name: 540-J Motor
hopUps.description: Replacement Tamiya 540-J brushed motor. The standard motor used across many vintage Tamiya vehicles, providing a reliable and consistent power output.
